title: Finite custody-role ingress ownership
change: Four receiving owners are acquired before channel/body allocation and retained through parsing, signing, response delivery, startup failure, cancellation and genuinely late credential-bound transport.
meaningfulCoverage: Actual loopback HTTP prepare and malformed/oversized-body refusal; actual role receiver saturation before candidate reads; startup failure/recovery; four acknowledged blocked private calls retained after cancellation.

title: Exact current role workload issuance
change: A typed exact workload grant binds identity/bearer hash/role/scope/intent and immutable grant commitment. Final issuance is conditionally ordered against the same independently surviving revocation head after awaited original/control/native reads; prepared calls and signed role statements retain binding and cannot outlive the actual grant.
meaningfulCoverage: Actual independent receiver issuance/revocation CAS; prepare/authorize/control/native/direct observer revocation and exclusive expiry during awaited reads; exact repeated preparation, historical optional signature fields and typed comparison preserving original raw bytes.

title: Enrolled held SQLite identity and placement
change: Existing-only SQLite acquisition pins every path component, actual main-file descriptor and existing independent storage identity, holds a directory writer fence and verifies transaction/journal boundaries. DELETE journals are the implemented selected protocol; WAL/shm and links deny.
meaningfulCoverage: Disposable exact identity/restart, final and parent links, journal/WAL/shm boundaries, replacement during open and transaction, original rollback preservation and current workload mutation ordering.

Disposable tmpfs refusal, restored-locator SQLite descriptor substitution, shared/unknown/sparse pool-extent denial before native dispatch, and unshared-but-default-COW Btrfs refusal. Fixed-slot writes implement ext4/XFS only and perform no fresh allocation/probe at completion.

title: Canonical bounded new attempt identifiers
change: New reserve INSERT accepts only bounded canonical UUID text. Existing immutable attempt rows remain readable and are recovered without rewrite or a new reservation.
meaningfulCoverage: Disposable malformed/nonstring/990000-character/uppercase/braced IDs refuse without INSERT; valid UUID runner paths and exact legacy-row lookup/recovery.

title: Recoverable unadmitted physical preparation
change: New physical reservation follows count/size refusal checks. Preparation/admission/reconciliation share the pool/volume fence. Only exact authoritative nonadmission after an acknowledged fresh-etag head barrier can release an unadmitted ticket; delayed old-etag, uncertain, admitted and lost-ack outcomes remain fenced or charged. Private, spool and recovery-grant paths use the implemented protocol.
meaningfulCoverage: Actual receiving count-limit refusal, repeated distinct losing CAS, delayed old-etag CAS after proven reclamation, uncertain barrier preservation, restart, concurrent exact retry and lost successful reply; shared real receiver pressure/completion fixtures.

Actual retained recovery grant after lost publication uses one immutable grant-bound reserved transfer across randomized ECDSA re-signing before publication; existing immutable signature bytes remain unchanged and settled archived reissue completes after ordinary free-space/probe denial.

title: Immutable physical budget commitments
change: Tickets retain original owner/kind/request commitment, initial bytes/completion and transfer metadata independently of mutable Remaining. Exact retries after transfer are allowed; conflicting request/final/nonterminal/budget/owner reuse and unknown legacy commitments deny before admission.
meaningfulCoverage: Actual uncertain terminal-at-admission preparation versus larger nonterminal and changed-body requests at the same role/id; identical retry; direct immutable owner/budget/body comparison after partial transfer.

Actual retained recovery grant after lost publication uses one immutable grant-bound reserved transfer across randomized ECDSA re-signing before publication; existing immutable signature bytes remain unchanged and settled archived reissue completes after ordinary free-space/probe denial.

title: Existing durable shared phase completion capacity
change: Before new native admission the phase owner reserves an existing physically preallocated shared result slot under the enrolled directory writer fence. Signed exact completion is published into fixed preallocated bytes, requiring no post-effect SQLite page/journal/WAL/directory allocation. SQL originals and all legacy result_json bytes remain exact; unknown effects use lookup only.
meaningfulCoverage: Actual disposable retained phase owner refuses missing capacity before dispatch; lost completion-header acknowledgment retains exact signed frame and recovers after restart without native lookup/resend; injected ordinary allocation refusal during completion and NULL SQL result recovery.

Disposable tmpfs refusal, restored-locator SQLite descriptor substitution, shared/unknown/sparse pool-extent denial before native dispatch, and unshared-but-default-COW Btrfs refusal. Fixed-slot writes implement ext4/XFS only and perform no fresh allocation/probe at completion.

Selected free-slot materialization and4KiB alignment precede SQL/native admission; a failed materialization leaves no admission/dispatch and recovers exactly. Expiry winning during materialization denies at the final SQL boundary. Admitted completion requires private written extents and does not allocate/convert unwritten extents.

title: Exact complete Python/C# binding encoding
change: C# hashes the complete preserved binding using the existing Python ensure_ascii canonical identity, Unicode scalar property order, Python escaping (including DEL and supplementary pairs) and supported JSON numeric forms. Legacy Python binding identity and raw accepted originals are unchanged.
meaningfulCoverage: Actual Python-to-C# byte interoperability over non-ASCII values/keys, controls/DEL/escaping/supplementary keys, ordering, arrays/objects/null/bools, big integers, negative zero, exponent thresholds and finite double boundaries; real Python-prepared accepted packet consumption.

title: Accepted stable immutable launched sibling graph
change: Production accepts complete byte inventories for existing published immutable release bundles, validates the whole selected seven-resource graph, kernel immutable namespace/fs-verity inputs and selected static ELF kernel-load closure before adding any resource, and launches through held process-anchored descriptors. Development keeps source projects. Leases are owned during AppHost Build/Dispose through tracked HostOptions configuration. Both packet producers require and retain the actual manifest and its complete canonical joint binding.
meaningfulCoverage: Actual Aspire builder accepted graph, changed nonproject source/project/dependency/unlisted member/replacement and immutable-kernel refusal with preexisting unrelated resource preservation; accepted stable fixture graph and Build/Dispose release; scripts and dynamic loaders refuse even when their bytes are re-pinned; production Python mutable graph refusal, complete fixture graph under explicit fixture-only kernel proof, changed bytes and packet substitution.

title: Protected transfer slots and serialized completion metadata
change: Admission reserves worst supported publication-path transfer slots and future serialized ledger growth across all owners/restarts; completion bytes and metadata slots are protected from nonterminal history use. Actual outstanding transfers plus reserved slots cannot exceed4096 and actual bytes plus future growth cannot exceed4MiB. Limits/history are preserved.
meaningfulCoverage: Exact4096 transfer-marker and4MiB serialized-growth boundaries reject new ingress while already admitted completion succeeds; immutable budget metadata and real competing receiver/lost publication/restart pressure cases.

Actual retained recovery grant after lost publication uses one immutable grant-bound reserved transfer across randomized ECDSA re-signing before publication; existing immutable signature bytes remain unchanged and settled archived reissue completes after ordinary free-space/probe denial.

title: Exact current still-pending physical coverage
change: Legacy reconciliation subtracts only tickets whose role/id/body commitment is proven to match exact current still-pending owner originals/publications. Completed-but-unsettled, zero-row, different and stale-revision tickets cannot release unrelated legacy completion coverage.
meaningfulCoverage: Completed-but-positive unsettled ticket with unrelated pending legacy reserve, settlement and restart/stale revision; actual receiving commit/settle paths and existing interrupted zero-row settlement source fixture.

title: Actual version2 observe/restart/native receipt routing
change: A version2 target drives the actual ObserveAsync path, serialized spool persistence, process-object restart and actual EventStore recorder identity selection through drain. Legacy version0 identity remains exact.
meaningfulCoverage: Persisted SourceVersion2, exact hashed security-event-log aggregate/receipt stream and native recorder command assertions; legacy version0 exact locator tests remain enabled.
